<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="List">456f69b847516a106274efbb616d43bc</macroponent><name>List Modal</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function handler({
        api,
        event,
        imports,
        helpers
    }) {
    
    const { name, payload: { route, fields, params, size = 'md', ariaLabel }} = event;
    
    if (name === 'LIST#CLOSE_MODAL')
        helpers.modal.close();
    
    else if (name === 'LIST#OPEN_MODAL') {
        if (!route)
            return;
            
        api.setState('bare', true);
        api.setState('displayOptions', { size: size, label: ariaLabel });
        api.setState('contents', {
            route: route,
            fields: fields,
            params: params
        });
    }
    
}]]></script><script_api_version>1.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>KHARRF@ecolecatholique.ca</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-05-01 16:10:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>916f2db847516a106274efbb616d432e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>List Modal</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Triage 2.0" source="x_ndecd_triage_2_0">c48de0481bafed508d594047bc4bcb3d</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Triage 2.0">c48de0481bafed508d594047bc4bcb3d</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_916f2db847516a106274efbb616d432e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>KHARRF@ecolecatholique.ca</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-05-01 16:10:36</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
